item.title: AIM-424 “Malice” Very Long-Range Air-To-Air Missile Emerges From The Shadows
item.summary: The Navy's newest extreme-range air-to-air missile is intended to be used by the F/A-18E/F Super Hornet, F-35C JSF and the upcoming F/A-XX. The post AIM-424 “Malice” Very Long-Range Air-To-Air Missile Emerges From The Shadows appeared first on TWZ .
